author: Alexey Evlampiev
name: Portico CLI
description: A Portico CLI with one route, one executable example, and a green contract test.

porticoVersion.description: The Portico package version to reference. Defaults to the version this template package shipped with.

Framework.description: The target framework for the scaffolded projects.

manualInstructions.text:
cd into the new directory, then:

  dotnet test        every [CliCommandExample] runs against the real pipeline

Then break it on purpose: rename --name to --who in IGreetTool.cs and run
dotnet test again. The example stops dispatching and the build goes red — your help
output cannot drift from the CLI you shipped, because it is the test.

More in README.md.
